Test Case Title: Open the page and check the status is "Ready" and only Input Box 1 is visible.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the 'Hidden Elements & AJAX' page of the practice site
Test Steps: 1. Open the Hidden Elements & AJAX page. 2. Read the status. 3. Check Input Box 1, Input Box 2 and Checkbox 2.
Expected Result: The status is "Ready", Input Box 1 is visible, Input Box 2 and Checkbox 2 are hidden.

Test Case Title: Toggle Input Box 2 twice and check the status "Input Box 2 shown" then "Input Box 2 hidden".
Preconditions: Browser is open on the 'Hidden Elements & AJAX' page of the practice site
Test Steps: 1. Click the toggle button of Input Box 2. 2. Check the box and the status. 3. Click the toggle button again. 4. Check the box and the status.
Expected Result: After step 2 the box is visible and the status is "Input Box 2 shown". After step 4 it is hidden and the status is "Input Box 2 hidden".

Test Case Title: Toggle Checkbox 2 twice and check it is shown and hidden again.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the 'Hidden Elements & AJAX' page of the practice site
Test Steps: 1. Click the toggle button of Checkbox 2. 2. Check the checkbox and the status. 3. Click the toggle button again. 4. Check the checkbox.
Expected Result: After step 2 the checkbox is visible and the status is "Checkbox 2 shown". After step 4 it is hidden.

Test Case Title: Show Input Box 2, type "now visible" and check the text is kept.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the 'Hidden Elements & AJAX' page of the practice site
Test Steps: 1. Click the toggle button of Input Box 2. 2. Type "now visible" in Input Box 2. 3. Read its value.

Test Case Title: Click the AJAX load button and check the content "AJAX Content Loaded" appears after the delay.
Preconditions: Browser is open on the 'Hidden Elements & AJAX' page of the practice site
Test Steps: 1. Click the load AJAX content button. 2. Wait for the content.
Expected Result: The content contains "AJAX Content Loaded" and "This is some dynamic content loaded through AJAX.".

Test Case Title: Load the AJAX content and check the status label shows "AJAX content loaded".
Preconditions: Browser is open on the 'Hidden Elements & AJAX' page of the practice site
Test Steps: 1. Click the load AJAX content button. 2. Wait for the content. 3. Read the status.
